reviewScope: Separate driver source/package binding, SDK subset, original error and final evidence handling

findings.summary: The original host loads the first document asynchronously; a legitimate initial about:blank can be returned before loadUrl. Current graphics.js labels every non-target document an error, and initial wait immediately fails that error rather than using the declared initialization budget.
findings.requestedCorrection: Represent only exact about:blank as an explicit initial-pending state and permit it only during the initial readiness wait; retain rejection of foreign/later documents and all genuine Observer/game errors. Add boundary tests and rebuild the separate unsigned Observer only.

otherChecks: Nine source hashes match the owner inventory; local Java/Node/driver logs were read, not rerun.
Handler.post plus a request-local ten-second latch replaces the initially unbounded runOnMainSync; late callbacks affect only their abandoned private result.
Console hook does not replace an existing Chrome client, requires no existing URL, preserves WebViewClient and changes no game model/input/renderer.
Cached snapshot uses original controller.peek, no consuming native poll or GL getContext/getError/readPixels.
Driver fixed original APK and separate Observer identities remain distinct, only one normal SDK subset is executed, status is diagnostic-completed and formalAcceptance stays false.
Final independent system PNG and all GET outcomes are retained; rejected preflight never triggers final device observation.
New target35 original v7 installation completed in 10.57s; old target29 per-app confirmation is correctly excluded.
limitations: No signing, credential read, game rebuild, install, WebView/native run, browser run or workflow dispatch was performed in this independent review.
The startup issue is source-proven possible ordering, not a claimed original native failure or a proven cause of the blank-track screenshot.
